page.layout: Running head centred at the top, page number at the top right. Two circular medallion portraits side by side, each with its legend around the rim. Below them one column of running text with two paragraphs. No margin notes. Gathering signature at the foot.

main_text.l: P · CASTRENSIS · P.
FRANC · ZABARELLA
PAULUS de Castro, Jureconsultus celeberrimus, multa
conscripsit ad leges pertinentia, stylo non minus elegati quàm
utili, quibus, vir admirabilis suæ eruditionis & prudentiæ testi-
monia omnibus clara exhibuit. Jus docuit, in omnibus ferè
claris Italiæ Academiis. Scripsit super Codice lib.9.super ff. ve-
teri lib.24. Consilia elegantissima, singularia, & opus Consilio-
rum in duo volumina partitum, cum pluribus aliis cōmētatio-
nibus composuit: ut posteritati, singulari beneficio, & propensa
in studiosos omnes, voluntate, sese profuturum aliquando glo-
riaretur, quemadmodum ipsis profuit qui eodem seculo vixe-
runt. Scripsit etiam super ff. novo libros duodecim: super ff. in-
forciati, libros quatuordecim: super Institutis lib.quatuor. Cita-
tur quoque repetitio eius in i.ff.ver. de indiciis, l. si de vi. Con-
silia eius ab erroribus vindicata & additionibus, novisque rerū
notabilium summis, supra priores editiones feliciter aucta, stu-
dio & opera Leonardi à lege, Venetiis impressa sunt 1570. in fo-
lio, & anno 1571. Claruit anno reparatæ salutis humanæ 1437.
ZABARELLA natione Patauinus, Roma. ecclesiæ Car-
dinalis presbyter juris pontificij consultissimus, unde amplissi-
mam dignitatem suam exornavit, ut prelatos decet, erat maxi-
mo ingenio & doctrina præditus, cuius specimen frugiferum
edidisse eum, ipsius scripta satis testantur. Floruit circiter an-
num Domini 1443.

page.notes: The medallion legends are printed in capitals around the rims: left "P · CASTRENSIS · P.", right "FRANC · ZABARELLA" (the first word runs along the lower left). The page number is only partly legible on the scan. The signature "Vvv 4" is printed at the foot. Long s has been written as plain s throughout; u/v and i/j are normalised as instructed.
